findings.claim: The diff adds two test-support modules, `frontend/e2e-components/reading-text-size.cases.ts` (where all assertions live) and `frontend/e2e-components/readingTextSize.data.ts` (shared fixture strings), that the touch-point list does not name. The list names only `fixtures/app.tsx`, a fixture module, the two spec files, `projects.ts` and `spec-viewport.spec.ts`.
findings.impact: No user-visible impact. Both files are test-only and sit under `frontend/e2e-components/`, which the Tests touch point covers in general. The touch point describes 'two spec files with the same assertions', but the real assertions are in a third shared module, and both spec files are 3-line wrappers. A reader who looks for the assertions in the spec files will not find them there.
findings.evidence: In the diff, `frontend/e2e-components/reading-text-size.cases.ts` is new (434 lines) and exports `readingTextSizeCases(width)`. `reading-text-size.spec.ts:3` calls `readingTextSizeCases(393)` and `reading-text-size-desktop.spec.ts:3` calls `readingTextSizeCases(1280)`. `frontend/e2e-components/readingTextSize.data.ts` is new and is imported by both `fixtures/readingTextSize.tsx` and `reading-text-size.cases.ts`. Neither path appears in the touch points.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant is broken. The two files are a factoring of the declared test touch point, and only the list's wording leaves them out.

findings.proposed_fix: Name `reading-text-size.cases.ts` and `readingTextSize.data.ts` in the Tests touch point, or accept them as covered by `frontend/e2e-components/`.

specification_compliance: Every production file in the diff appears in the touch-point list: DESIGN.md; PassageList.tsx; ImageQueryViewPresenter.tsx; passage-rows.html; CommentSection.tsx; FileDescription.tsx; MetadataEditor.tsx; CollectionDetail.tsx; QuickNotePresenter.tsx; and in the intelligence submodule SummarySection.tsx, VisualDescriptionSection.tsx, PictureTextSection.tsx, CitationInlinePanel.tsx, AskTab.tsx and Page.tsx.

docs/specs/reading-text-size.md, docs/specs/INDEX.md and docs/process/reviews/feature-reading-text-size/** are implicit touch points and are not reported.

The test files fixtures/app.tsx, fixtures/readingTextSize.tsx (a new fixture module that app.tsx imports), projects.ts DESKTOP_ONLY, spec-viewport.spec.ts, reading-text-size.spec.ts and reading-text-size-desktop.spec.ts are all declared. The only unnamed paths are reading-text-size.cases.ts and readingTextSize.data.ts (TP-1).
SummarySection's in-place edit textareas use `!leading-relaxed`, as the touch point requires; globals.css is not in the diff.
potential_unspecified_behavior: fixtures/readingTextSize.tsx replaces `window.fetch` when the module loads. app.tsx imports it, so every arrangement in the component bundle now goes through this wrapper, not only the reading-* ones. The routes match only rt* file ids and `/api/drives/fixture/collections/rtcollect001`, and app.tsx's own module-level wrapper chains on top of it, so I see no effect on other arrangements. Still, this reaches fixtures beyond the declared surfaces.
regression_risks: The module-level fetch patch in fixtures/readingTextSize.tsx is shared by all component arrangements. A later arrangement that reuses an rt*-style id or the collection path rtcollect001 would silently get this fixture's answers.

Passage rows and image-query document rows grow taller with the 16px excerpt. passage-rows.html was updated by hand and has no parity test, so if the static copy drifts from the real class, passage-rows.spec.ts can pass while measuring something other than the real row.
